chk_source_connections_key_request_atomi.name: chk_source_connections_key_request_atomic
chk_source_connections_key_request_atomi.value: ("source_connections"."key_request_token_hash" IS NULL AND "source_connections"."key_request_expires_at" IS NULL AND "source_connections"."key_request_fields" IS NULL AND "source_connections"."key_request_created_at" IS NULL) OR ("source_connections"."key_request_token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "source_connections"."key_request_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "source_connections"."key_request_fields" IS NOT NULL AND "source_connections"."key_request_created_at" IS NOT NULL)

favourites_type_fields_check.name: favourites_type_fields_check
favourites_type_fields_check.value: ("favourites"."type" = 'folder' AND "favourites"."kind" IS NULL AND "favourites"."ref_id" IS NULL) OR ("favourites"."type" = 'item' AND "favourites"."kind" IS NOT NULL AND "favourites"."ref_id" IS NOT NULL)

idx_saved_consoles_sched_due.name: idx_saved_consoles_sched_due
idx_saved_consoles_sched_due.where: "saved_consoles"."schedule_cron" IS NOT NULL AND "saved_consoles"."schedule_cron" <> '' AND "saved_consoles"."scheduled_run_next_at" IS NOT NULL AND "saved_consoles"."is_deleted" = false

app_usage_daily_viewer_exclusive.name: app_usage_daily_viewer_exclusive
app_usage_daily_viewer_exclusive.value: NOT ("app_usage_daily"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app_usage_daily"."anon_id" IS NOT NULL)

app_usage_events_viewer_exclusive.name: app_usage_events_viewer_exclusive
app_usage_events_viewer_exclusive.value: NOT ("app_usage_events"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app_usage_events"."anon_id" IS NOT NULL)

chat_part_metadata_non_empty.name: chat_part_metadata_non_empty
chat_part_metadata_non_empty.value: "chat_message_part_metadata"."provider_metadata" IS NOT NULL OR "chat_message_part_metadata"."call_provider_metadata" IS NOT NULL OR "chat_message_part_metadata"."result_provider_metadata" IS NOT NULL

chat_message_parts_type_fields_check.name: chat_message_parts_type_fields_check
chat_message_parts_type_fields_check.value:
(
        ("chat_message_parts"."part_type" IN ('text', 'reasoning') AND "chat_message_parts"."text_value" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_message_parts"."tool_call_id" IS NULL AND "chat_message_parts"."file_url" IS NULL)
        OR ("chat_message_parts"."part_type" = 'file' AND "chat_message_parts"."file_url" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_message_parts"."file_media_type" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_message_parts"."tool_call_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("chat_message_parts"."part_type" = 'tool' AND "chat_message_parts"."tool_call_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_message_parts"."tool_name" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_message_parts"."tool_state" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_message_parts"."is_dynamic_tool" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("chat_message_parts"."part_type" = 'step-start' AND "chat_message_parts"."tool_call_id" IS NULL AND "chat_message_parts"."file_url" IS NULL)
        OR ("chat_message_parts"."part_type" IN ('source-url', 'source-document') AND "chat_message_parts"."extra_payload" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("chat_message_parts"."part_type" = 'other' AND "chat_message_parts"."raw_type" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_message_parts"."extra_payload" IS NOT NULL)
      )
